# Jaikrishna Industries

> Premium Manufacturer & Global Exporter of Kalasam & Temple Dharisana Brands. Leading manufacturer and exporter of synthetic camphor (CAS 76-22-2), D-camphor (CAS 464-49-3), isoborneol (CAS 124-76-5), camphor oil (CAS 8008-51-3), pure pooja camphor tablets, deepam lamp oil, incense sticks (agarbathi), sambrani dhoop cups, and steam-distilled rose water. Operating from Theni, Tamil Nadu, India, supplying wholesale, B2B, temple, OEM, and global export buyers across 17+ countries.

## Overview & Background

India's leading manufacturer and exporter of synthetic camphor, D-camphor, isoborneol flakes, and organic intermediates under the brand names Kalasam and Temple Dharisana. Trusted by global buyers across 17+ countries.

### Company Highlights
- **Founded**: 1995 (Over 25+ years of manufacturing experience)
- **Headquarters & Manufacturing**: Telephone Nagar, Theni, Tamil Nadu-625531, India.
- **Phone**: +91 6383020848
- **Email**: support@kalasamjaikrishna.co.in / export@kalasamjaikrishna.co.in
- **WhatsApp Support**: +916383020848
- **Business Hours**: Monday – Saturday: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM IST
- **Key Brands**: Kalasam, Temple Dharisana
- **Annual Production Capacity**: 10,000+ Metric Tons
- **Purity Standard**: Up to 99.9% batch-tested purity
- **Export Reach**: Serving buyers across Asia, Middle East, Africa, Europe, and North America (Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Malaysia, Singapore, Nepal, Bhutan, UAE, Saudi Arabia, Oman, Qatar, Kuwait, Indonesia, Vietnam, Thailand, Nigeria, Kenya, United States)
- **Certifications**: ISO 9001:2015, FSSAI Certified, GMP Certified, MSME Registered, IEC Certificate, GST Registered, UDYAM Registered, BIS Standards

## Industrial Chemical Products

- [Industrial Chemicals Overview](https://kalasamjaikrishna.co.in/industrial-chemicals): Bulk industrial chemical catalog, specification downloads, and B2B ordering information
- [Synthetic Camphor](https://kalasamjaikrishna.co.in/products/synthetic-camphor): Synthetic Camphor (CAS: 76-22-2), Assay: Technical Grade (≥96%) - High-purity synthetic camphor powder for pharmaceutical, fragrance, and chemical manufacturing applications.
- [D-Camphor](https://kalasamjaikrishna.co.in/products/d-camphor): D-Camphor (CAS: 464-49-3), Assay: ≥98% (Dextrorotatory) - Dextrorotatory natural camphor for pharmaceutical and specialty chemical applications.
- [Isoborneol](https://kalasamjaikrishna.co.in/products/isoborneol): Isoborneol (CAS: 124-76-5), Assay: Technical Grade (≥95%) - Industrial-grade isoborneol powder for fragrance synthesis and chemical intermediate manufacturing.
- [Camphor Oil](https://kalasamjaikrishna.co.in/products/camphor-oil): Camphor Oil (CAS: 8008-51-3), Assay: Natural Essential Oil Grade - Pure camphor essential oil for fragrance, pharmaceutical, and industrial applications.
